biggest_catch: The BUS-2026 window ends 2026-09-30 (7 days from verification) - the MICH-BUS variant runs to 12/31/26. Requires $15,000 (or $5,000) within the first 7 CALENDAR DAYS of opening, and the bonus is not paid until the sixth month after opening (with clawback if closed within 6 months).
catches: Must be a new FMB business checking client; existing business checking customers or those who closed an FMB business checking account within 12 months of the offer start date (on or after 3/1/26) are not eligible.
Must ask an FMB banker to enroll you in the 'BUS-2026 Checking Offer' when opening a new Basic Business Checking account between 3/1/26 and 9/30/26.
$750 tier: deposit at least $15,000 within the first 7 calendar days of account opening. $300 tier: deposit at least $5,000 within the first 7 calendar days of account opening.
Account must maintain a $5,000 monthly average collected balance or a $20 monthly service fee applies.
Bonus credited to the new account in the sixth month following account opening ('New Checking Offer Reward').
If the account is closed by you or FMB within 6 months of opening, you may be charged up to the full offer amount plus a $50 early closing fee.
Employees not eligible; not valid for Public Funds, Estate accounts, U.S. Government entities, other banks, or financial institutions.
One per client; awarded at FMB's sole discretion; offer may change or be discontinued at any time.
FMB may report the reward value to the IRS; recipient responsible for taxes.

steps: Open a new First Merchants Basic Business Checking account between 3/1/26 and 9/30/26 and ask an FMB banker to enroll you in the BUS-2026 Checking Offer.
Deposit at least $5,000 ($300 tier) or $15,000 ($750 tier) within the first 7 calendar days of account opening.
Maintain a $5,000 monthly average collected balance to avoid the $20 monthly service fee.
Keep the account open; the bonus is credited in the sixth month following account opening.
